image_description: A close-up view of a motorcycle front wheel assembly featuring a dual-disc braking system. The image shows two perforated metal rotors mounted to the wheel hub, clamped by calipers. A silver telescopic fork leg is visible on the left, along with a black tire and rim. The background is a paved surface.
